description: Produce a small standard-library Python module from a registered, deterministic template, plus the pytest tests that verify it. Choose this when you need one small, importable standard-library Python module whose behaviour matches a registered template, delivered with a passing pytest suite you can re-run yourself. Do not choose this for a multi-file package (use python-multifile-package), for code needing third-party packages, or when you cannot name a registered template: the behaviour is fixed by the template and an unregistered request is rejected rather than guessed. Example requests: Write me a small Python function that turns a title into a URL slug, with tests. | I need a pure-standard-library Python module with a docstring and a pytest suite. | Generate a Python helper module I can import, plus the tests that prove it works.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

function_name.description: Name of the function the module must define.

module_name.description: Lowercase module name, used for the file name.

template.description: Which registered behaviour to produce. The behaviour is fixed by the template and verified by the template's own tests.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).
